title: Prod release sign-off: RBAC v2 + audit schema changes
content:
Purpose:
This doc collects the release readiness checklist and sign-off artifact for the RBAC v2 rollout and associated audit-log schema change. It centralizes the launch gating criteria, exception approval process, SIEM export requirements, and links to automated evidence collection. Use this doc during the release window and attach completed items to the JIRA SRV-1189 release task.

Scope and high-level summary of changes (short):
- RBAC v2: role inheritance model introduced, new resource-scoped permissions, and a service-account token type for inter-service calls.
- Audit log schema: added fields (actor_type, actor_service, resource_path_v2, action_hash) and tightened timestamps to ms resolution; logs now include request_id and route_variant.
- Evidence automation: CI job that snapshots policy diffs, export of sample logs for compliance, and automated S3 bundling of artifacts for retention.
- SIEM export update: normalized JSON transform for Splunk Heavy Forwarder and new enrichment keys for identity mapping.

Pre-launch (must be completed before deploy window):
1) Architecture sign-off: Security lead must confirm RBAC v2 design aligns with threat model (JIRA-SRV-1189 -> reviewer: Elena Varga).
   - Evidence: CONFLUENCE-Page-5532 review comments exported (attach to JIRA).
2) Schema compatibility test: run backward-compatibility suite for audit consumers (JIRA-AUD-2034).
   - Pass criteria: older consumers tolerate missing new fields using safe defaults.
3) SIEM mapping: verify transform rules in staging pipeline (docs.redwood.ai/internal/siem-exportation).
   - Evidence: staging Splunk index contains normalized identity fields for 48h.
4) Canary plan documented: traffic split, rollout percentage steps, and rollback criteria entered into release task (SRV-1189).
5) Data residency and retention check: ensure retention TTLs for audit logs meet compliance policy C-PL-09.
6) Automated evidence job enabled: CI job rbac-evidence-bundle runs on deploy branch and uploads artifacts to s3://redwood-evidence/prod/rbac-v2/.

Launch window checklist (to be executed during the deployment):
- Deploy RBAC v2 service and migration job (deploy aka PR-472). Confirm zero-blocking migration or gradual migration plan executed.
- Start audit-log producer with new schema flag in "staging" mode; emit both v1 and v2 schema where possible for first 30 minutes and monitor consumers.
- Observe ingestion rate into SIEM and check for dropped events >0.1% threshold.
- Verify service tokens rotate correctly and service-account auth flow is functional (sample calls, call traces in logs).
- Run smoke tests that exercise permission inheritance and a sample of edge-case resources (tickets: SRV-1189-01..-05).
- Capture snapshot of policy state before and after migration (artifact saved by evidence job).

Post-launch verification (first 72 hours):
- Daily audit of suspicious deny trends (security SRE): run the provided query (JIRA-AUD-2034 -> checks/deny-trend).
- Consumer validation: contact teams flagged in linked_artifacts list, confirm no parsing errors or schema exceptions in their pipelines.
- Automated evidence collection: confirm S3 bundle contains (policy-diff.json, sample-logs.jsonl, migration-report.txt, siem-verify.txt).

Sign-off table (fill in signatures in JIRA SRV-1189 by tagging names):
- Security Lead: name and date (required) -> Elena Varga
- Platform Eng (runtime): name and date (required) -> Samir Patel
- Observability / SIEM owner: name and date (required) -> Noah Kim
- PM / Release Owner: name and date (required) -> Arielle Chen
- Legal / Compliance (if PII or regulated scope changed): name and date (conditional) -> Diego Alvarez (reviewed 2026-02-18)

Exception approval flow (for any checklist items that cannot be met):
1) Raise an exceptions ticket under JIRA-AUD with tag "release-exception". Include detailed compensating controls and expected remediation date.
2) Security will triage and assign risk owner; if residual risk > medium, escalate to Compliance for approval.
3) Approval requires: written compensating control, mitigation steps, and monitoring plan. Evidence must be attached to the exception ticket.
4) If exception is granted, log the exception ID into the release sign-off section and add it to the release artifacts S3 bundle.

SIEM export acceptance checklist (engineers to verify):
- Field normalization: actor_id, actor_type, service_name, env, request_id present for >=99.5% of events in the test window.
- Timestamp fidelity: ms resolution confirmed and timezone normalized to UTC.
- Enrichment: identity mapping table applied (verify sample of 200 events contain mapped identity).
- Backpressure handling: when SIEM endpoint is slow, events must queue and not drop; verify no drops during 5m induced latency test.
- Schema doc published at docs.redwood.ai/internal/siem-exportation and referenced in audit ticket.

Automated evidence artifacts produced by CI: (verify presence)
- policy-diff.json (pre/post role definitions)
- migration-report.txt (rows migrated, errors, timing)
- sample-logs.jsonl (first 1k events post-migration)
- siem-verify.txt (field coverage stats)
- exception-records.csv (if any)

Rollback criteria (if any of the below met, trigger rollback and follow post-rollback playbook):
- >1% production errors attributed to auth/token validations for more than 10 minutes across customers.
- Significant consumer parsing failure rate (>5% of consumers reporting errors in JIRA-AUD-2034).
- SIEM ingestion gaps >0.5% for 30m or critical monitors missing identity fields.

Open questions / action items (from last review meeting):
- Q1: Does the service-account token type require a distinct rotation cadence? Owner: Samir Patel. (action: propose cadence by 2026-02-25).
- Q2: Confirm all partner integrations (internal partner apps) have been invited to testbed environment. Owner: Noah Kim.
- Q3: Legal to confirm whether actor_service field introduces new PD data classification. Owner: Diego Alvarez.

Related artifacts and references (quick links):
- RBAC v2 design doc: CONFLUENCE-Page-5532
- JIRA tasks: JIRA-SRV-1189 (release bundle), JIRA-AUD-2034 (audit compatibility), JIRA-SEC-2102 (exception backlog)
- PR implementing changes: github.com/redwood-inference/rbac/compare/PR-472
- SIEM transform guide: docs.redwood.ai/internal/siem-exportation

Notes / informal runner-up checklist (notes to release engineer):
- Keep a short running slack thread titled "#release-rbac-v2-YYYYMMDD" and paste the s3 artifact URL there.
- If a consumer needs a hotfix, tag the PR and attach the hotfix plan to SRV-1189 as a subtask.
- Use the automated evidence job logs (ci/rbac-evidence-bundle) as primary proof for compliance; manual screenshots are accepted but less preferred.

If you are reading this during the release window: please update the sign-off table in the related JIRA, attach the S3 evidence bundle, and ping @security-release on Slack.

Revision history:
- 2025-11-08: initial draft (Arielle Chen)
- 2025-12-10: added SIEM acceptance criteria (Noah Kim)
- 2026-01-27: clarified rollback thresholds and automated evidence list (Samir Patel)
- 2026-02-20: added legal review note and finalized sign-off table (Diego Alvarez)

End of document.
